english: Host, I have come. Give me back my son. What price do you seek? Five horses and a hundred sheep. He is strong; he is worth ten horses. I do not have ten horses. I beg (you), release my son to me. Drive them here, and he will go home with you. May the gods give you good things.
uncertain: h₁áyso me: clitic me read loosely

english: Brother, are you alive? I am alive. The master struck me three times with the whip. Why did he strike you? Last night a calf perished in the woods. I did not see that track(?) and that (calf). Lie down. I will bring you water. Let the master not see you. You are a brother to me.

Sister, are you awake? I am awake. My two hands are torn from the heavy work. Sleep does not come to me. I remember my mother's face. Do you remember your home? I remember it. Enemies burned it and drove me off with blows. At dawn let us two flee. Do not say that. The master's dogs are listening. Sit quietly now.

Why, mother, are we not free? Your father was a captive, and I am the master's servant. A servant's son is a servant. Where is my father? He died in the great snow in winter. He ran away, and the cold killed him in the rocks. Still I will flee when I grow up. Do not say that aloud(?). The master hears everything.

Why did you flee my house? Lady, hunger. Your mistress did not give me meat. Where did they find you? At the river. The dogs caught me. If you run again, I will sell you to strangers. Now he will lead you with a rope on your feet. Bind me, but give me meat. A hungry man does not work. You will eat with the pigs.

Lady, my child is coughing. Give me a little milk. I give milk to my own children. Servants drink water. If your son coughs, watch him at night. I remember that. Please give milk and do not tell the master. Lady, you are dear to me.
